title: Performium Revived
description: As a fan of the Minecraft Content Creator KasaiSora, I really hope the Performium could be continuously updating, thats why I create this project.
body:
# 🚀 Performium Revived Welcome to **Performium Revived**, an unofficial, fan-driven continuation of the original Performium modpack by [maybeizen](https://modrinth.com/user/maybeizen), which was a team member of Membercat Studios. When the original project was discontinued, this project was created to keep the pack updated, optimized, and running smoothly for the community. All credit for the original concept, configuration philosophy, and branding goes entirely to [maybeizen](https://modrinth.com/user/maybeizen). --- ## ⚠️ Project Status & History
Click to view the original message from maybeizen regarding the archive > "I, unfortunately, have decided to archive Performium. This is a personal choice of mine and I've basically lost all motivation to work on this project as a whole. Also, with the fact that I just left Membercat Studios and have brought the project with me, I feel like now would be a good time to say goodbye and halt all updates. > > You are free to use Performium as a base for your own modpack, continue developing it as part of a new project, or use the name in your content without needing my permission. The original ARR license is no longer binding. > > TL;DR: Do whatever you want with the files."
*Note: Please **do not** contact KasaiSora or maybeizen for support regarding this revived version. If you experience bugs or performance issues, use the community links provided below.* --- ## 📋 About Performium Revived Performium Revived remains true to the original vision: a lightweight, optimized Fabric-based modpack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience with stunning visuals, seamless textures, and quality-of-life improvements—all while maintaining excellent performance. ### ✨ Features * **✅ Enhanced Visuals** – Stunning shaders, connected textures, and refined models. * **✅ Optimized Gameplay** – Smooth mouse controls and performance tweaks. * **✅ Minimalist Approach** – Keeping the mod count low and highly efficient. * **✅ Broad Compatibility** – Built for modern Minecraft versions and works flawlessly on: * 🟢 Modrinth App / Prism Launcher / ATLauncher --- ## 📥 Installation (Modrinth App) 1. Download & Install the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app). 2. Log in with your Minecraft account. 3. Click **Browse** on the left sidebar. 4. Search for **Performium Revived**. 5. Download and install the project! --- ## 🏷️ Versioning System Performium Revived follows the original structured versioning format: `v[GameVersion]-[Stage]+[Build]` * **`v[GameVersion]`** → Uses Minecraft Versioning * **`[Stage]`** → Alpha, Beta, or Release * **`[Build]`** → Build Number for that specific version --- ## 💬 Support & Community Because this is a fan-maintained revival, **please do not reach out to [maybeizen](https://modrinth.com/user/maybeizen)'s old contact emails for support.** If you encounter issues, have performance questions, or want to report a broken mod, please reach out me by email at henry@wayyyyysal.xyz or join our community discussions on Discord.
